Assign rows to K-Means clusters.

Fits K-Means to selected numeric features and appends an Int32 cluster_id column to the input table.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Category | [Analytics](../categories/analytics.md) |
| Status | Runs |
| Also read from graphs as | `KMeansCluster` |
| Search words | kmeans, cluster, clustering |

## Inputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Data** | Dataset | Yes | 1 | Input table containing numeric features |

## Outputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Clustered** | Dataset | Yes | 1 | Input table plus cluster_id |

## Settings

| Group | Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Columns | Feature columns | `feature_cols` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Comma-separated numeric features; empty auto-detects numeric columns. |
| Columns | Label column | `label_col` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Optional label column excluded from automatic feature detection. |
|   | n_clusters | `n_clusters` | Integer | `8` | `1-2147483647` | The run | Number of clusters. |
|   | max_iter | `max_iter` | Integer | `300` | `1-2147483647` | The run | Maximum fit iterations. |
|   | init | `init` | Choice | `kmeans++` | `kmeans++`, `random` | The run | Centroid initialization. |
|   | n_init | `n_init` | Integer | `10` | `1-2147483647` | The run | Independent initializations; retains the lowest-inertia fit. |
|   | tol | `tol` | Number | `0.0001` |   | The run | Convergence tolerance. |
|   | seed | `seed` | Integer | `0` | `0-2147483647` | The run | Random seed; 0 selects nondeterministic initialization. |
|   | standardise | `standardise` | On / off | `false` |   | The run | Scale each feature to z-scores before fitting (Explore > Groups does) |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).

## Where it runs

| Where | Runs |
| --- | --- |
| Data pipeline (run the graph, **Run step**, previews) | Yes; the result can be saved as a table |

The node runs on the device chosen for the run (CPU or a GPU); a node does not fix a device.
